visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A brightly lit indoor living room environment features two women seated on a grey sofa. One woman on the left, with dark hair tied in a bun and wearing a white shirt under a dark grey pinafore dress, is holding and reading a physical book. Beside her, another woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a black t-shirt with white text and baggy blue jeans, is looking intently at her purple smartphone. Behind them, a white wall and a decorative plush pillow are visible. (2) The scene transitions with dynamic white motion lines as a man in a dark green button-down shirt and grey trousers appears. He leans over and physically lifts the woman in the black t-shirt from the sofa, carrying her away. The woman in the pinafore dress remains on the sofa with a surprised facial expression. Yellow and white text captions appear at the bottom of the frame. (3) The setting changes to an outdoor urban pedestrian street with various colorful shop signs and banners in the background. The woman in the dark pinafore dress and a young man in a white short-sleeved shirt and grey shorts are standing together, talking and gesturing with their hands. Passers-by and urban infrastructure like streetlamps are visible in the background. (4) A product montage sequence begins in a retail-like studio space with wooden decor and plants. Several Google Pixel 10 series smartphones in colors like mint green, silver, and obsidian are displayed on white stands. The three main characters are shown interacting with the devices, and digital screen overlays demonstrate software features like camera guides and text-based AI interactions. (5) The final phase takes place outdoors on a stone ledge with green bushes and tall city buildings in the background under a clear sky. All three characters are seated together, each holding a smartphone. The young man in the white shirt gives a thumbs-up, and the man in the green shirt reappears to drag him away, leaving the two women laughing on the ledge.
